answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 14 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 461 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The garden test is the live device, the river test is the locked stake, and the marble test is the graded history no template can fake.
